In 2050, some dwellings that exist in today’s ResStock model will have been demolished, whereas others will have been retrofitted with new equipment, and new dwellings will have been built. All these changes could impact the results. If deep energy efficiency with significant building envelope improvements is widely adopted, the thermal response of the dwellings might change. Last, a further comparison of the thermal decay of the ResStock models to empirical data could be performed. Ideally, this comparison would result in improvements to the ResStock models. How much these changes would affect the presented results is unclear. 30 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications.
